# Lesson 1 Lab source and generated files

- `lab_worksheet.md`: canonical student worksheet source.
- `bike_rentals.csv`: reproducible synthetic teaching dataset with three missing cells and one duplicate row.
- `lab_worksheet.html` and `lab_worksheet.pdf`: generated student formats.
- `lab_solution.ipynb`: canonical instructor solution, matching Weeks 2–11.
- `archive/lab_solution.md`: retained legacy Markdown solution; do not edit or publish it.

The student worksheet is designed for 50 minutes of core work plus a 30-minute MPS439 extension. Update `lab_worksheet.md` before rebuilding the rendered worksheet formats, and edit the solution directly in `lab_solution.ipynb`.
